::: {#exm-hers-risk-difference}
#### Risk difference of regular exercise in HERS

With the placebo group as the reference group,
the estimated risk difference of @def-risk-difference
for the estimated risks of @exm-hers-outcome-risk is:

```{r}
#| label: hers-risk-difference
#| code-fold: false
rd_hat <- risk_hat[["hormone therapy"]] - risk_hat[["placebo"]]
rd_hat
```

The estimated risk of regular exercise is `r round(rd_hat, 3)` higher
in the hormone therapy group than in the placebo group.
Multiplying by 100 gives `r round(100 * rd_hat, 1)` percentage points.
:::
